name: fragment
description: Build money flows in your app (prepaid credits, wallets, payouts, escrow, spending limits) on a Fragment ledger whose rules the ledger itself enforces, and prove them with an independent judge.

fragment_mcp_url.title: Fragment MCP URL
fragment_mcp_url.description: Your workspace's MCP URL, from the Fragment dashboard: Workspace Settings > MCP > Add > raw URL. Leave empty to use the skills and the CLI without the MCP tools.
